sql:
SELECT month_of_half,
       half,
       ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (PARTITION BY half ORDER BY month_of_half), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 6
              THEN 'Erstes Halbjahr' ELSE 'Zweites Halbjahr' END AS half,
         CAST(((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 6) + 1 AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,
         -SUM(amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND subcategory = 'Supermarket' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY half, month_of_half
)
ORDER BY half, month_of_half

       CASE WHEN booked_on <= '2025-08-31' THEN 'August' ELSE 'September' END AS period,
